limitations: Qualitative compactness and strict-singularity facts for multiplication operators are prior art. The quantitative result is restricted to normalized symmetrically normed Banach ideals contained in compact operators on separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space; it does not cover quasi-Banach ideals or general elementary sums. For two noncompact coefficients the essential-norm quantity is only a lower bound.
provenance: Scientific sources and proof evidence are documented in RESULT.md and the dated independent-audit files.
record_title: Flat classical s-number profiles for one-sided multiplication on symmetric norm ideals
